name: Nitrogen Cold-Gas RCS Thrusters
summary: High-pressure gaseous nitrogen reaction control thrusters mounted near the top of Stage 1.
function: Provide 3-axis exoatmospheric attitude control after MECO to execute the 180° booster flip maneuver and hold retrograde orientation prior to atmospheric reentry.
materials: Composite-overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) storing high-pressure nitrogen feeding machined stainless/Inconel cold-gas thruster pods.
history: Because aerodynamic surfaces have no authority above ~70 km, SpaceX added dual redundant nitrogen cold-gas pods on the interstage—producing the iconic glowing twilight plumes seen during flip maneuvers.
sources: Public SpaceX Launch Webcast Technical Commentary
